PM Activities Performed Annually: Visually inspect the rotor shaft for corrosion and wear.

Visually inspect the shrink disk for corrosion, wear, and physical damage. Retighten the gearbox shrink disk connection, and grease it in accordance with the manufacturer's recommendations. Retighten a sample of 10% of the shrink disk bolts. If any one bolt can be turned more than 20º, retighten all of the

bolts on the flange. Visually inspect the rotor lock for corrosion, wear, and physical damage. Check the bolted connection of the rotor lock device. Perform a functional test of the rotor locking device.
Visually inspect the rotor lock for corrosion, wear, and physical damage. Check the bolted connection of the rotor lock device. Perform a functional test of the rotor locking device.
Check the bolted connections of the coupling flange.
Replace the incremental encoder every 10 years.
